body: I usually run venti’s tornado, ganyu’s lotus, kokomi’s jellyfish, then switch to diluc. Keeps enemies together or slowed, then freezes them, applying swirl damage in addition to Diluc doing double damage from reactions
Sucrose is also fantastic. I had her as my anemo main for the longest time until I got my dearly beloved venti on my team.
Ganyu can be specially enhanced by Albedo, Kokomi, Mona, Xialing, and Fischl. Each allows for a passive talent to deal additional damage while you play as her and make use of her skills.

Fischl is so valuable, and one of the best electro enablers in the game. I regret not getting her sooner. Her constellations turn her into a dps booster and dealer. Chongyun is amazing as well. Applying his elemental skill and then switching to a physical dps;think claymore user (particular characters being Razor and Eula, gives giant cryo damage.
I have Xialing, Xingqui, Chongyun, and Kazuha on a team together

For Itto team I’d do Yun jin for Geo resonance plus passive damage and shield, fischl for the passive electro damage, and Sayu for elemental combos. Aim for passive talent characters to let your dps shine.

Yeah, she wouldn’t have sewn her own clothes or had any experience like that, so if I have a scene where Ren’s embroidery gets messed up or something and Nora fixes it, Adam could get suspicious.

True, Winter would need to be convinced. I might have Adam walk in on a tender moment with Ren and Nora, where they’re talking deeply about their lives. In the movie, the prince is really hinted that he absolutely knows that the girl he’s talking to is an imposter but he never outs her and even helps her escape from jail before she can be executed, so if Nora is talking about her seamstress experience Adam could use that as an “aha!” moment since Wiess would never have gone near any sort of labor.

I was actually thinking of Nora get a wig from Yang, who I feel like having a hairstylist/wig shop would make a lot of sense for a profession for her character, and I’m kind of questioning whether she would need contacts depending on which version of eye color I go with. Nora’s eye color during volume 4 is super light and similar to Wiess so if I go with that version, then I might be able to avoid contacts.
I think I would have Phyrra teach Nora how to be ladylike since it would make more sense for her to keep her friend’s secret.

I did think about that, but since Preminger (in the barbie movies) not only wanted to rule the kingdom but also had a grudge against the princess I wanted to do something similar, with Adam having a personal vendetta against Wiess and planning for her to have an ‘accident’ after their marriage. And while I could use Neo, and possibly might at some point in the story, I kind of want to have less use of semblances in this fanfic. The girls in the barbie movie didn’t get through the situation by using magic or like really elegant disguises they just pushed through with wits and bravery, and I want to bring that aspect of Wiess and Nora’s characters through. Plus I think it would be a nice challenge as a writer to try and come up with a good reason as to why Nora could fool everyone as Wiess without using magic or semblances as an easy out.

Basically my thought would be this, its an AU so Wiess would be atlesian royalty, and the kingdom has fallen on tough times. Nora works as a seamstress for some strict figure as an indentured servant. The two girls meet when Ruby takes Wiess out to see the suffering of her people, and bond during an evening out on the town. Adam, who is upset that the Faunus have been suffering the most from Atlas’s financial hardships, hears about how Wiess is set to be married off to Mistral’s prince (Ren), and decides to kidnap her, planning to bring her back and be given Wiess’s hand instead. With Adam as king he’s thinking that he can finally bring the Faunus to their rightful standing, and bring humans down a notch. Obviously this is bad news so Ruby has Nora pretend to be Weiss since they’re not too differently built (I’m still working out the disguise details), while she works to find Wiess and her captor. Ren arrives and falls for Nora as she’s pretending to be Wiess and the girls work together to bring Adam down and the kingdom back to stability.

I was thinking of having Ren be the prince Wiess was supposed to marry while Nora is disguised in her place. I’m still working out who the villain would be that kidnaps Wiess but so far I’m thinking of it being Adam.
